text:
A: Hiya! You're Craig, yeah? I'm Kerry, Swindon. You remind me of my husband, by the way, that's a compliment.
B: Ha. Er, okay. Thanks. Yeah, Craig. Lowestoft.
A: Lowestoft. Is that Norfolk?
B: Suffolk. Just. Yarmouth's Norfolk.
A: Right, sorry, I'm terrible with that side of the country. Never had a reason to go, do you know what I mean? So what do you do?
B: Erm. Nothing at the minute. I was a welder. Back went.
A: Oh, you're Mark's mate! He said he had a lad on with a bad back, you were swapping notes.
B: Ha. Yeah, that's me. He's a laugh, Mark.
A: He is, isn't he? He was my favourite so far, no offence. My back's bad too, actually. Lower back, comes and goes. I get migraines and all. I keep meaning to go to the GP but you can never get an appointment in Swindon, it's like winning the lottery.
B: Yeah. I've got a physio. Took ages to get, mind.
A: See, that's the thing. So what are you going for, then, job-wise?
B: Erm, something lighter. Maintenance. Maybe forklift. I dunno really.
A: Honestly, have you thought about sales? Trade sales, like I do. I'm business development for a building supplier. You'd know the products, the contractors would trust you because you've actually done the job. That's half the battle. And there's a bonus.
B: Er... I dunno. I'm not really a phone person.
A: Nobody is at first. You just get on with it.
B: Yeah. Maybe. Fair enough.
A: Is that your wedding photo behind you?
B: Yeah. Gemma. Got married in church, back home.
A: Aw. We did registry office then a massive do at a hotel near Marlborough. Best party of the year, everyone said. Where'd you go on honeymoon?
B: Tenerife.
A: Oh, I love Tenerife! Which bit?
B: Erm, the south. Can't remember the name. Big hotel, pool.
A: Playa de las Americas, prob. We've done Tenerife twice, Lanzarote, Turkey. Dubai was the best though. Have you been?
B: No. Money's a bit tight at the minute, so. Might do a couple of nights somewhere for our anniversary. Norfolk or something.
A: That's nice though. Cosy.
B: Yeah. It's alright.
A: Dan's always on at me about money. He's careful, I'm not. He'd get on with you.
B: Ha. Gemma does all the money in ours. Probably for the best.
A: That's what Mark said! Everyone's wife does the money. Except me, obviously.
B: Ha. Yeah.
A: Have you got a dog? I've got Biscuit, cockapoo, he's a menace.
B: Staffy. Dexter. He's alright. Dodgy stomach.
A: Oh no. Biscuit just eats shoes. Sixty quid trainers last week, I could've cried.
B: Dexter had a sausage roll off the floor. Up at three with him.
A: Oh, gross. Right, well, I'd rather the trainers then.
B: Yeah. Probably.
